result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, and the new test and the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass offline. Nothing is committed.

The changes:
- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `.htm`, `.html` and `.xhtml` (`.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`).
- **.NET documentation XML:** the path is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. It was `.*/[.]xml`.
- **`// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches. It was `.*/[.]js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the path is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. It was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`.

I added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the new files match, that `build.gradle` and a Doxygen `.html` page still match, and that a hand-written `.htm`, `.xml` and `.js` stay out of the generated scope.

One thing I noticed but left alone: the generic `//[ ]*Generated by .*` content rule has no path pattern and scans every line of a file, so a `// Generated by` comment anywhere in any file counts as generated. That is outside this task.
